verifiedFields: opaque scalar and 22 other presence-gated fields

historicalLua: gadgets[].level (present in individual Lua; omitted by prior CSV)
runtimeOrComputed: cityId and parentAreaId derived by RewardAreaResolver

currentlyExposedForChestInRewardBranch.type: chestType from fork metadata or known prefab-name pattern

currentlyExposedForChestInRewardBranch.level: SceneGadget.level whenever meta exists; absence versus 0 not represented
currentlyExposedForChestInRewardBranch.tag: declared selector key but not populated in WorldChestLootHelper
currentlyExposedForChestInRewardBranch.kind: declared selector key but not populated in WorldChestLootHelper
currentlyExposedForChestInRewardBranch.point: declared selector key but not populated in WorldChestLootHelper
currentlyExposedForChestInRewardBranch.world_level: declared selector key but not populated in WorldChestLootHelper

discriminatorRules: Scope first by reward Gadget content/caller and only then add instance metadata.
Use (scene,group,config) as instance identifier where genuine groups exist; synthesized spawn IDs may require a separate provenance.
Gadget ID may participate but never exclusively decide normal vs searchpoint, Mora, Remarkable, boss, or grade.
Do not coerce historical combat/puzzle and regional drop-tag text into official grade.
Do not equate native Lv1..Lv5 prefab suffixes, 4-grade chest rarity, and Audio Mid/Hi/Top.
A field absent from scene Lua is not proof of a real zero/false value.
Exclude rewards and probabilities from the research deliverable.
